title: Mediated Sign-In error response
description: An OAuth error response from the token endpoint to a Mediated Sign-In token request, with HTTP 400 (Mediated Sign-In 4, 5). code_required has the sign_in_id to send with the one-time code, sent_to, saying where the code went, and expires_in, in seconds. The other errors are invalid_grant, expired_token, access_denied, invalid_scope, and the usual token endpoint errors (oauth-error.schema.json). A successful sign-in returns token-response.schema.json. Unknown fields are allowed.
